name: OpenJutsu - MiniMax H3

refs.label: Reference pictures
refs.description: swap: exactly one (the new person). advanced_swap: one per person to replace (1-4), in the order of 'roles'. object_edit: at most one (what it should look like). check_mask: none.

prompt.label: Who is replaced (swap)
prompt.description: swap: who in the video the picture's person replaces, e.g. 'the singer'. Not a free generation prompt.

roles.label: Who each picture replaces (advanced_swap)
roles.description: One line per reference picture, e.g. 'the drummer - man in a cap'. Only the part before ' - ' reaches H3; the rest helps match people. Empty lines are named by screen time.

target.label: What to replace (swap, check_mask)
target.description: What SAM tracks; the biggest match is replaced ('person' by default, or 'cat').

object_target.label: What to change (object_edit)
object_target.description: Words SAM tracks, e.g. 'hair' or 'hair, top' (comma separated). For 'background' it is what stays (e.g. 'person'). Not used by 'add'.

change_to.label: What it becomes (object_edit)
change_to.description: change/background: the new look or place in words (or use a picture). remove: what shows instead, only when not obvious. add: the object, e.g. 'a chocolate cake on a plate'.

biggest_only.label: Only the biggest match of each thing (object_edit)

placement.label: Where to add the object (object_edit add)
placement.description: JSON list of keyframes {"frame":0,"x":0.4,"y":0.5,"width":0.2,"height":0.2}, fractions of the frame. One keyframe stays fixed on screen.

action.label: What the added object does (object_edit add)

hat_fix.label: Also replace hats (about 45 s more per clip)

no_lip_sync.label: No lip-sync (for songs the people do not sing along to)

per_person_pass.label: One pass per person (advanced_swap, exactly 2 pictures, about 2x time)

motion_reference.label: Motion reference size in px (768 is about a third slower)

duration.label: Seconds of the video to use (default: all)

mask_margin.label: Edit-mask grow in px at SAM's 1008 px canvas (swap/advanced: 20 tight, 40 normal, 60 loose; object_edit: 10/20/40)

accept_experimental.label: Run an operation that has no real-inference validation record yet

notes: Operations: swap (simple, validated), advanced_swap, object_edit, check_mask; see operation_status for each one's evidence. Port of the 'simple swap' of D3voz/openjutsu (MIT, github.com/D3voz/openjutsu @ 7fe118b, workflows/simple.api.json pruned and patched as in lib/simple.ts, lib/model.ts and lib/comfy.ts with upstream's default settings: hat fix off, No lip-sync off, margin 40, motion reference 512, 6 steps, 6 s clips, euler). Replaces the main person of a video with the person in ONE reference picture; SAM 3.1 masks, MiniMax H3 reference-to-video, the source soundtrack is kept; longer videos are generated in overlapping clips by the Context-Loop nodes. Differences from upstream: H3 text encoder is the official INT8 file (upstream names an INT4 file); the graph is static (no per-request pruning). The 'prompt' input is NOT a free generation prompt: OpenJutsu builds the H3 prompt itself; the text fills the Swap Plan 'roles' field (who is replaced, for example 'the singer'; text after ' - ' only helps the shot describer). Output length is rounded down to H3's frame grid (17k+5 frames per clip), so up to about 0.67 s can be dropped from the end (measured: 72 -> 56 frames, 242 -> 226, 107 -> 107, 73 -> 73). Default masking (hat fix off) can leave parts of the original clothing, such as sleeves, in some frames; raise mask_margin to loosen the edit mask. ComfyUI keeps about 70 GiB resident after a job until the idle timer or POST /v1/models/<id>/unload; a second job queued meanwhile waits for the ledger's 120 s minimum residency. Same video, picture, prompt and seed resume from the clips already saved in ComfyUI/output (upstream behaviour): change the seed for a fresh run.
